overview.text: aiXiv.online presents an independent archive for AI-assisted research, starting with mathematics, unaffiliated with arXiv or Cornell University. Its proposed research packet combines a paper, a verifiable GitHub repository and complete agent sessions, with a timestamped content-hashed priority record. That records provenance and timing, not correctness, ownership or independent scientific validation. The page offers papers, problems, a digest, forum and submission documentation. Different homepage sections report different corpus counts; prominent breakthrough and affiliation claims are not independently established. This is distinct from aixiv.science.
